subject: Stakeholder mapping & champion enablement — Redwood + Finovate
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@finovate.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@finovate.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-18T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps — Redwood + Finovate

Hi Sara / Tom,

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment and clear next steps.

Key takeaways:
- Decision criteria: predictable latency (p95 < 250ms for core flows), per-embedding cost, and enterprise security controls (SOC2, data retention and audit logs).
- Economic buyer: Tom indicated Finance will own budget approval (CFO/VP Finance).
- Procurement/legal: procurement@finovate.com will require a completed security questionnaire and SOC2 Type II evidence; legal will want standard DPAs and limited data retention terms.
- Champion: Sara is excited to lead internal advocacy and schedule the security/procurement review.

Proposed next steps:
1) I attached a one-page Mutual Action Plan (MAP) outlining timelines and owners.
2) I'll send an ROI/total-cost-of-ownership deck with sample numbers based on your token volumes.
3) Schedule a 30-minute security + procurement call next week to walk through SOC2 and the questionnaire.
4) Sara, if you can confirm the procurement contact and availability, we'll loop them in and share the MAP.

Attachments: 20270618-Redwood-MAP-Finovate.pdf, 20270618-ROI-deck.pdf

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0147

I also created a short champion enablement note below you can forward to stakeholders — short talk tracks + ROI bullets.

Champion enablement (for Sara to share):
- One-line: Redwood helps Finovate reduce inference cost by ~35% while maintaining strict latency and security SLAs.
- Talk track for Finance (Tom): example cost model showing current vs projected monthly spend and payback timeline (attached ROI deck).
- Talk track for Procurement/Legal: SOC2 Type II available; data retention configurable; we have enterprise DPA and can support reasonable contract terms.
- Talk track for InfoSec: we can run a live security walkthrough and deliver the completed questionnaire before procurement approval.

Please confirm Wed 10am PT for the budget sync and I'll send a calendar invite + security call invite for early next week. Calendly: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/redwood-security-call
